chunks: "If he fears for himself because of those praying with him, he should pray the last two rak'ahs and make them voluntary prayers."

key_terms.خَافَ: feared or was apprehensive of harm
key_terms.نَفْسِهِ: himself; his own person or safety

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in salat if he fears harm because of those praying with him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat in a situation of fear or danger arising from those praying with the person. It indicates that the final two rak'ahs may be performed and treated as voluntary prayers in order to address that circumstance.
